changelog: Lock the note type and slide-order outline first, then generate while reusing the same approved visual anchors. Do not add extra paid calls just to produce another style set.

en.description: Create a Xiaohongshu or REDnote carousel from a post outline, product details, photo set, or style reference. Build an ordered 3:4 image sequence with a hook cover and supporting slides, clear focal imagery, matched visual direction, and headline-safe areas for product recommendations, tutorials, food notes, OOTD, travel guides, knowledge posts, and Xiaohongshu content images for one connected post story. Optionally it reads Xiaohongshu itself — the notes already running for the topic, one page of a note's top comments, and an account's own recent notes — so Xiaohongshu research, competitor note analysis and comment analysis rest on the platform instead of on guesswork.
en.summary: Turn a post outline, product details, photo set, or style reference into an ordered 3:4 Xiaohongshu carousel with a hook cover and coherent supporting slides.
en.title: Zhongcao Carousel Maker: Xiaohongshu Carousel Posts

zh.description: 使用 AI 将笔记选题、内容大纲、商品信息、照片或风格参考转为小红书轮播图、小红书图文和小红书多图笔记。依照封面钩子、内容顺序和统一视觉方向制作 3:4 图文配图，预留标题区域，适用于种草、教程、好物测评、美食、穿搭、旅行攻略和知识卡片。还能选做一步：直接读小红书上同题材笔记正在跑的一页笔记、某一篇笔记的一页热门评论，以及账号自己近期的笔记，做小红书竞品笔记分析和评论区分析，让内容有依据而不是凭印象。
